subject: Assimilation path request: Saffron family variant onboarding & interim pin
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah@saffron.ai>
Cc: Saffron Eng <eng-poc@saffron.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Assimilation path request: Saffron family variant onboarding & interim pin

Team — looping you on a new model intake from Saffron Labs. They shipped a family of Saffron-XL variants this morning (13B base + two trimmed "lite" variants). We need a quick internal assessment of compatibility and a recommended pin plan so we can onboard the compatible variant to Hosted and Dedicated without breaking existing customers.

High-level asks:
- Can Engineering confirm whether the 13B base (tag: saffron-13b-v2) is compatible with our runtime (A100/Triton, continuous batching, KV cache) and quantization paths?
- If not, which variant is the minimal viable candidate we can expose (name the tag)?
- Product: recommend temporary pin duration and whether we require a gating window / canary for 1% traffic.
- Ops: any infra/kernel work required and ETA?

Saffron provided a variant comparison (attached) and a small eval sample. Sarah, thanks for the quick turnaround.

Goal: decide by EOD Wednesday (2026-11-11) so we can schedule a canary the following week. If approved, I plan to ask for a temporary pin on the chosen variant to avoid auto-roll for 8 weeks while we observe telemetry.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Sr. Product Manager — Model Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: saffron-variant-comparison.csv, saffron-eval-sample.jsonl

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lim <sarah@saffron.ai>, Saffron Eng <eng-poc@saffron.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Assimilation path request: Saffron family variant onboarding & interim pin

Quick tech read from my side after a fast pass on their artifacts and a small local run against our CI harness:
- saffron-13b-v2 (preferred upstream) uses a custom rotary embedding variation and a fused attention op that is not yet present in our Triton kernel set. On A100 this manifests as an op fallback to slower CUDA kernels; latency at p50 is +28% versus our baseline 13B. KV cache semantics look standard, but the rotary math needs a kernel update.
- saffron-13b-int8-rev1 (they offered an int8-optimized variant) currently passes our int8 quantization path on local rigs. It hits a ~1.6x throughput improvement vs saffron-13b-v2 with similar generation quality on our eval samples.
- saffron-lite-3b is fully compatible and is the cleanest path for immediate exposure but has lower quality for our gen tasks.

Recommendation: Do NOT pin saffron-13b-v2 as-is. Short-term option: onboard saffron-13b-int8-rev1 as the default variant for public Hosted, run a dedicated kernel update sprint (estimated 3 weeks) to enable fused attention for v2, then switch once we validate perf.

I attached the eval snippets and the failing op trace to the shared Drive link. If Product wants a conservative approach, we can canary saffron-lite-3b first for 1% traffic while we finalize kernel work.

— Dev
Eng, Inference Runtime

> Attachment: saffron-eval-sample.jsonl
> Logs: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2bSaffronVariant/view

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Assimilation path request: Saffron family variant onboarding & interim pin

Thanks for the context. A few product constraints to weigh in: 
- We have two active customers (beta) already on our 13B baseline; we should avoid regressions for them.
- Operations prefers we do a canary on Dedicated first before exposing new variants on Hosted to limit blast radius.
- For a temporary pin, propose an 8-week pin with an automatic telemetry check at week 3 and week 6 (quality and latency delta thresholds). If we see >5% latency regression or >3% quality regression on the evaluation prompts, trigger rollback.

Plan proposal:
1) Canary saffron-lite-3b on Dedicated (1 host, 48h) for perf baseline.
2) If stable, promote saffron-13b-int8-rev1 to Hosted as the initial public variant with a 1% canary for 72h.
3) Parallel kernel sprint for fused attention (3 weeks). After kernel is in, run back-to-back perf/quality evals; if parity hit, schedule switch to saffron-13b-v2 and remove pin.

Ask: Karthik — please confirm whether we need an SLA exception to run the kernel update on the Dedicated clusters or if this can be scheduled in a normal maintenance window.

Marissa
PM, Model Platform

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Sarah Lim <sarah@saffron.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Assimilation path request: Saffron family variant onboarding & interim pin

Thanks — good write-up. Approving the conservative plan with the following clarifications:
- SLA/maintenance: Ops can schedule the kernel update during a scheduled maintenance window for Dedicated clusters. No SLA exception required; we will notify affected customers and coordinate a 2-hour low-traffic window.
- Temporary pin: approve an 8-week pin on the variant we promote to Hosted (saffron-13b-int8-rev1), with automatic telemetry checks at weeks 3 and 6 as proposed. Pin expiry target: 2027-01-04 with the option to extend to 2027-02-01 if kernel sprint slips.
- Canary sequencing: Dedicated 48h -> Hosted 1% 72h -> ramp. Dev, please file the INF ticket for the kernel sprint and include performance targets (p50 latency within 10% of baseline, p95 within 15%).

Alex — can you send a short summary back to Sarah at Saffron and ask them to hold the saffron-13b-int8-rev1 artifacts under a compatibility tag so we can reference them during canary?

Karthik
Director, Model Infrastructure

> Forwarded for visibility to Saffron: please hold artifacts under tag "compat/saffron-13b-int8-rev1" until we complete canary.
